evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies core wallet rescan logic in src/wallet/scan.cpp.
rationale: Parallelizing BIP 157/158 filter evaluations delivers a substantial 4.5x to 7x speedup for wallet rescans on multi-core hardware. Benchmarks reported by the author and verified by multiple reviewers show a 200,000-block scan dropping from ~272 seconds on master to 25–63 seconds with worker threads.
